quarterly_data.signal: Prysmian acquired an established high voltage cable jointer training facility in North Ayrshire, Scotland, bringing more than 20 apprentice jointers and the training staff into Prysmian, to support installation and IMR (inspection, maintenance and repair) operations for underground and subsea high voltage transmission cable projects in the UK and across Europe.
